tags.name: Dari Laut
tags.qa_note: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-20 (wreck deep-dive per QA policy): Re-confirmed via michaelmcfadyenscuba.info (deepest frame ~25m, shallowest ~12-13m) and scubadiverlife.com (frame intact, rest picked apart for scrap; nudibranchs, flatworms, scorpionfish, reef fish schools). Two NEW independent sources found: puertoparrot.com (frame tilted 13m-28m, cites 1970s date and mentions mandarin fish / crab-eye gobies) and scubaspotadvisor.com ('barge transformed into a floating resort' in the 1970s). CONFLICT FOUND: build/operation decade is disputed across sources -- some say 1980s (McFadyen-era secondary accounts, linesoflatitudes), others say 1970s (puertoparrot, scubaspotadvisor) -- decade left unresolved in description per anti-hallucination policy rather than picking one. Sinking cause remains fire (2+ sources) with unverified arson-for-insurance local speculation; no source confirms an alternative lightning-strike account closely enough to cite. No verified vessel dimensions or tonnage found in any source -- still explicitly stated as unknown. No Wikipedia article exists for this wreck (confirmed via search).
